coverage_gap_note:
Union coverage: 81.9% (1034/1263 executable lines in solution.patch) after normalizing all suites to the union instrumented denominator. F2P is at the **maximum** PR contribution: all 67 methods in the NEW test_type_params.py + all 20 in NEW test_type_aliases.py + 1 test_ast.test_type_params_feature_version = 88 selectors (verified that test_typing.py has NO net new methods; test files outside the 7 modified ones are untouched). Even with the maximum public-API behavioral test surface, the gap persists in three structurally-hard-to-reach categories:

  - Parser/parser.c (38%, 726-line gap): auto-generated parser-action tables for the ENTIRE Python grammar. PEP-695 syntax exercises only the new rule actions; the rest of parser.c is unchanged-but-recompiled code reachable only via other grammar tests (those tests are in P2P but they don't hit PR-NEW lines).

  - Python/Python-ast.c (24%, 427-line gap): auto-generated AST node visitor / field accessor stubs for ALL ast nodes; PEP-695 tests exercise only the new TypeVar / TypeVarTuple / ParamSpec / TypeAlias visitors.

  - Objects/clinic/typevarobject.c.h (14%, 316-line gap): argument-clinic-generated boilerplate for typevarobject constructors. Most lines are type-error/keyword-argument-error branches not triggered by valid public-API usage.

  - Objects/typevarobject.c (35%, 593-line gap): pickle/copy/deepcopy/reduce helpers + many low-priority dunder methods. Some are reachable via pickle.dumps(TypeVar) tests; CPython's own pickle tests for these in the PR's test_typing.py weren't added as F2P because the test file diff is a net rename/refactor (0 new methods).

The residual uncovered code is auto-generated boilerplate or pickle/copy/serialization helpers that would require fabricating tests beyond the PR — out of scope per §6's 'F2P/P2P from the PR itself' rule.

triage.test_level_policy: Augmented F2P selectors exercise PEP 695 behavior through public ast, keyword, typing, compile(), exec(), class/function metadata, and TypeAliasType surfaces; no project-defined internal symbols are referenced. Augmented P2P selectors exercise unrelated public stdlib/interpreter behavior that should pass at base, golden, and mutant states. Requirement section names exactly match the Section Classification Summary in requirement_pr_pairs/CPython_PEP-695_Type-Parameter-Syntax_PR-103764.md.

test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: ast.parse() and ast.unparse() over public class, function, async function, TypeVarTuple, ParamSpec, and type-alias syntax.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: PEP 695 requires type parameter lists to round trip through the public AST for classes, functions, async functions, variadic parameters, ParamSpecs, and type aliases. The test asserts the rendered public source keeps square brackets, stars, double stars, and the type statement.

test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: The CPython source distribution shipped in the benchmark image, plus keyword.issoftkeyword("type").
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: The grammar-change and generic-alias sections require the shipped grammar to define type-parameter productions and the type statement, and require type to be a soft keyword. Source-level checks catch source distribution regressions that generated parser artifacts can mask.

test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: typing.TypeVar union expressions with forward-reference strings, TypeVarTuple aliases, and ParamSpec Callable specialization.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: The library-change section wires new runtime typing helpers into public typing constructs. The test verifies forward-reference unions work through typing, while invalid multiple-TypeVarTuple and under-supplied ParamSpec substitutions are still rejected.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: exec() of PEP 695 class, function, and type-alias source plus public __type_params__, __parameters__, __name__, and __infer_variance__ attributes.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: PEP 695 says implicit parameters are runtime objects, are exposed in declaration order, infer variance automatically, and drive Generic metadata without explicit Generic bases. The test observes those properties through public class, function, and type-alias metadata.

test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: typing.TypeVar, typing.ParamSpec, and typing.TypeAliasType public constructors.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: Constructor validation is part of the public runtime representation. The test requires invalid variance combinations, invalid constraints, and non-tuple TypeAliasType type parameters to raise the documented public exceptions.

requirement_sections: Specification > Runtime Representation of Bounds and Constraints
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: exec() of PEP 695 source plus public __bound__, __constraints__, and TypeAliasType.__value__ attributes.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: Bounds, constraints, and type-alias values are lazily evaluated public attributes and must cache after successful evaluation. The test uses side effects visible from Python source to prove one evaluation and the correct exposed value.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: exec() of type-alias statements plus TypeAliasType.__type_params__, __parameters__, __value__, subscription, and union behavior.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: Generic aliases must expose declared parameters exactly, expose subscription parameters with the public unpacking semantics, reject subscripting non-generic aliases, and participate in union expressions. The test drives all checks through TypeAliasType objects produced by public syntax.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: exec() of class declarations plus public __bound__, __constraints__, and __type_params__ on classes and functions.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: PEP 695 distinguishes upper bounds from constrained TypeVars and requires __type_params__ to be a tuple, including the empty tuple for non-generic functions/classes. This test checks those public runtime classifications directly.

test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: compile() and exec() over PEP 695 source snippets, observing SyntaxError and public __bound__ resolution.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: The type-parameter-scope sections require duplicate parameter rejection, prohibit assignment-expression/nonlocal escapes in annotation scopes, and allow nested type-parameter bounds to see the enclosing class namespace. The test checks these outcomes through compile() and executed source.

requirement_sections: Specification > Accessing Type Parameters at Runtime
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: Public ast.TypeVar, ast.ParamSpec, ast.TypeVarTuple, ast.TypeAlias, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef constructors plus compile() and runtime __type_params__/__value__ metadata.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: The AST-change section makes type parameters first-class public AST nodes for functions, async functions, classes, and type aliases. This coverage-focused F2P constructs those public AST nodes manually, compiles them through the normal validator, and observes the resulting runtime metadata.

test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: Public typing.TypeVar, ParamSpec, TypeVarTuple, ParamSpecArgs/Kwargs, Callable specialization, tuple Unpack specialization, and class creation error behavior.
test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.rationale: PEP 695 moves the type-parameter runtime classes into the C-backed typing runtime while preserving public typing contracts. The test begins with PEP 695 syntax so it is F2P, then covers public dunder, repr, equality, mro-entry rejection, Callable ParamSpec substitution, and TypeVarTuple substitution behavior.

test.test_pep695_aug.TypeParameterSyntax.public_surface: compile() over public Python source strings covering PEP 695 class/type syntax plus existing lambda, comprehension, function, async, exception-group, pattern matching, f-string, with-statement, and invalid-syntax grammar paths.
